detail.longDescription: don’t mind me, just plodding along making my own handcrafted programming language (tentatively named “bee”). i’ve been working on it for a while. maybe it’ll be useful for others, maybe not. i like working on it it’s kind of a rust-like with some other design decisions that rust couldn’t do at this point. currently it compiles to c. i’ll add wasm and native backends after it’s self hosted # BeeLang # programming
